name: Motorola G54/G64
tagline: Experience the perfect blend of performance and customization with our Pixel-inspired custom ROM for your device.

steps.title: Unlock Bootloader
steps.description: Ensure your device's bootloader is unlocked before proceeding.

steps.title: Download the relevant files
steps.description: download the following files ROM zip and Initial install zip (The initial install zip has the boot and vendor_boot images bundled together).

steps.title: Flash the initial install zip
steps.description:
Turn off your device, push and hold the power and volume down button at the same time and release once the phone has booted into the Bootloader Mode. Open a Terminal / Command Prompt and run:
fastboot reboot fastboot
Moving on, type:
fastboot --skip-reboot update
and then drag-and-drop the initial install zip into the terminal and run it.

steps.title: Format Data
steps.description:
Once it has flashed without any errors, you may proceed by running:
fastboot reboot recovery
Then you can choose the Factory reset option on your device to format the /data partition.

steps.title: Flash Clover ROM
steps.description:
Select apply update using sideload & install the ROM by typing:
adb sideload CloverProject*.zip

steps.title: Reboot
steps.description: The first boot may take a few minutes. Enjoy Clover!

installationGuide.warning: Incorrect installation may brick your device. We are not responsible for any damage to your device. Proceed at your own risk.
